title: Trump says the war with Iran is militarily effectively over
caption:
After White House talks with Qatar's prime minister, President Trump said the war with Iran is militarily effectively over and new strikes seem unnecessary. The US naval blockade of Iranian ports continues. Iran wants the blockade and sanctions lifted before negotiating, and no deal has been agreed.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
